newsitem.title: ITALY: Alitalia Cargo signs Formula One deal.
newsitem.headline: Alitalia Cargo signs Formula One deal.

text.p: Alitalia Cargo said it had signed an agreement on Monday with the Formula One Constructors' Association (FOCA) to ship 11 racing cars competing in the 1997 Formula One Grand Prix to Melbourne.

The Italian carrier said in a statement that the cars -- three Ferarri, three Sauber, three Minardi and two Forti -- would be loaded on Alitalia all-cargo Boeing 747 leaving Milan's Malpensa airport for Melbourne on March 2.
The 1997 championship begins in Melbourne on March 9.
"The same service is envisaged for Brazilian, Argentine, Canadian and Japanese Grand Prix," the statement said.
Alitalia said it was the second year that it had provided the service to FOCA.
